earnings.title: Tenet Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results;
highlights: Net income available to common shareholders in third quarter 2026 was $1.000 billion, or $12.41 per diluted share compared to $342 million, or $3.86 in third quarter 2025
Adjusted diluted earnings per share 1 increased 79.5% to $6.64 in third quarter 2026 compared to $3.70 in third quarter 2025
Net income available to Tenet common shareholders $1,000
Net income available to Tenet common shareholders per diluted share $12.41

Net income available to the Company’s common shareholders in third quarter 2026 was $1.000 billion, or $12.41 per diluted share, versus $342 million, or $3.86 per diluted share, in third quarter 2025.

quotes.text: Our outperformance in the third quarter of 2026 was driven by sustained strength in same-store revenue growth and effective expense management.
quotes.by: Saum Sutaria, M.D., Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Tenet

outlook: FY 2026 Adjusted EBITDA Outlook is now expected to be in the range of $5.05 billion to $5.20 billion, a $195 million increase at the midpoint of the range; FY 2026 Adjusted Free Cash Flow outlook now expected to be in the range of $2.825 billion to $3.125 billion, a $100 million increase
